metadata.title: AI Settings & Secure API Key Management

story.iWant: to securely store my OpenAI API key in the application
story.soThat: I can use AI features without exposing my credentials
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create API Key Manager Service (AC: 3, 6) - Task 2: Implement IPC handlers for API key operations (AC: 3, 4, 7) - Task 3: Create AI Settings UI component (AC: 1, 2, 8) - Task 4: Implement API key testing logic (AC: 4, 5) - Task 5: Create AI state management store (AC: 6) - Task 6: Integrate AI Settings into main Settings UI (AC: 1) - Task 7: Add comprehensive error handling (AC: 5, 7) - Task 8: Write unit tests for API key manager service (Testing) - Task 9: Write integration tests for AI settings flow (Testing)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. AI Settings panel accessible from main application settings 2. Input field for OpenAI API key with password masking 3. API key stored using Electron's safeStorage (encrypted, per-project) 4. "Test Connection" button validates API key with OpenAI 5. Success/error messages displayed for connection test 6. Key persists across application restarts 7. Option to clear/reset stored API key 8. Settings panel uses shadcn/ui components (Input, Button, Label)

docs.doc: Defines api-key-manager.service.ts with responsibility: "Secure API key storage/retrieval using Electron safeStorage". Uses encrypted key stored in userData directory with decrypted key on retrieval in Main Process.
Specifies IPC handlers: ai-store-key, ai-get-key, ai-clear-key, ai-test-connection with typed request/response formats.
Mandates Electron safeStorage for OS-level encryption (macOS Keychain). API keys never logged or exposed to renderer directly.
Defines APIKeyStorage interface with encrypted string (Base64) and ISO 8601 timestamp.

story-context.constraints: - Process Separation: API key storage/encryption handled entirely in main process. Renderer never has direct access to encrypted keys. - IPC Communication: Use typed IPC channels following existing patterns in src/main/ipc/. Whitelist all channels in preload script. - Security: Never log API keys. Use Electron safeStorage API (requires Electron 13+). - Storage Location: Store encrypted key in app.getPath('userData')/ai-config.json - Component Library: Use shadcn/ui components (Input, Button, Label, Alert) for consistency with Epic 2, Story 2.6 - State Management: Follow Zustand patterns from recordingStore.ts and timelineStore.ts
story-context.interfaces:
<interface name="IPC: ai-store-key" kind="ipc-channel" signature="(apiKey: string) => Promise<IPCResponse<{success: boolean}>>" path="src/main/ipc/ai.handlers.ts"> Encrypts and stores API key using safeStorage
<interface name="IPC: ai-get-key" kind="ipc-channel" signature="() => Promise<IPCResponse<{key: string | null}>>" path="src/main/ipc/ai.handlers.ts"> Retrieves and decrypts stored API key
<interface name="IPC: ai-clear-key" kind="ipc-channel" signature="() => Promise<IPCResponse<{success: boolean}>>" path="src/main/ipc/ai.handlers.ts"> Deletes stored API key from userData
<interface name="IPC: ai-test-connection" kind="ipc-channel" signature="(apiKey: string) => Promise<IPCResponse<{valid: boolean; message: string}>>" path="src/main/ipc/ai.handlers.ts"> Validates API key with OpenAI (list models endpoint)
Core service for encrypted API key management

tests.standards: Unit tests use Vitest framework. Main process tests located in __tests__ subdirectories with .test.ts suffix. Mock Electron APIs (safeStorage) using vi.mock(). Integration tests mock IPC communication and external API calls. Follow existing test patterns from src/renderer/src/store/__tests__/
tests.ideas: - AC 3: Test encryption/decryption roundtrip with mock safeStorage - AC 4: Test OpenAI connection validation with mocked API responses (valid key, invalid key, network error) - AC 6: Test key persistence by mocking app restart (store, retrieve after simulated restart) - AC 7: Test clear key operation removes stored data - AC 8: Test UI renders shadcn/ui components correctly - Error cases: safeStorage unavailable, API timeout, malformed API key
